name: Otročiněves (Czechia)
description: Divided by diagonal lines running from the upper hoist towards the lower fly into a white triangle at the upper hoist, a red lower hoist part and a blue upper fly part, the red and blue separated by a yellow diagonal band.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 12 May 1997 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
